approvalRouteId.title: Approval route
approvalRouteId.description: Id of the ApprovalRoute the decision app holds for this route. Written once the route has been held there; empty until then. This is the mapping record that makes the migration auditable and lets a re-run skip the dispatch.

approvalRouteId.title: Approval route
approvalRouteId.description: Id of the ApprovalRoute the decision app materialised this voorstel's sign-off chain against. Empty when the decision app was absent or refused at activation, which is how an unmirrored voorstel is found: a best-effort step whose only trace is a log line is one nobody can audit.

concludeParafering.description: The decision app concluded the sign-off chain. Its decisive stage IS the accord decision, so a concluded route lands the voorstel directly on geaccordeerd; ter_accordering remains only for voorstellen the retired local runtime left mid-route. Written by the parafering conclusion recorder.
